subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub sponsor this staged experimental Claw publication contract and own the `CLAWHUB_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS` rollout boundary before the stack is merged?
rationale: VISION supports Claws strategically, but accepting a new package family and gated upload/distribution surface is a product and security-boundary commitment that cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the gated stack
options.body: Approve the staged rollout after the prerequisite lands and the contributor supplies redacted live proof for both enabled and disabled deployment behavior.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep the stack draft until maintainers are ready to own the experimental package-family and deployment-gate lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated stack
recommendation.body: Approve the staged rollout after the prerequisite lands and the contributor supplies redacted live proof for both enabled and disabled deployment behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are coordinating the proposed four-part implementation stack and can supply the requested runtime proof, while a repository decision owner must sponsor the direction.
